summary: Discrepancy between 87, 88, and 89 Change covered counts is caused entirely by non-seeded IntentClassifier initialization, causing marginal rank changes between 4th and 5th non-continue classes on boundary samples.

audit_conclusion.root_cause: The discrepancy between 87, 88, and 89 covered Change windows stems from non-deterministic initial weights in the IntentClassifier during ad-hoc script runs. In boundary sample ID 6290, 'stop' and 'accelerate' have marginal probability differences (~0.04-0.05). When 'stop' ranks 4th, the sample is good (88/211); when 'accelerate' ranks 4th, 'stop' is dropped to 5th, leaving the sample not covered (87/211).
audit_conclusion.canonical_selection: Canonical Static-K24 is frozen using canonical_intent_classifier.pth (Seed 43, 15 epochs on grouped_train_index), strictly matching the 88/211 (41.71%) baseline audited in AUDIT_STAGE_BEST_OF_4_GENERATOR_3SEED_20261007 and AUDIT_STAGE_PORTFOLIO_P0_COMPLEMENTARITY_20261007.
audit_conclusion.native20_invariance: Native20 candidates are 100% bitwise identical across all versions (max abs difference = 0.0).
